title: formPanel
description: Universal form layout from the Figma plugin template: vertical stack of label+control rows, text/number inputs, color pickers, and dividers. Registered under @layer global.

.form-panel.description: Root flex column for form rows.

.form-panel label.description: Horizontal row: caption left, control right.

.form-panel label.form-panel__vertical.description: Vertical variant: caption above full-width control.

.form-panel input[type=text|number].description: Styled text/number fields with focus border.

.form-panel .form-divider.description: Thin horizontal separator between form blocks.
